body:
Part of track #51. Decisions settled here.

## What
- A script (`scripts/smoke-pack.sh` or node) that: `npm pack` → install the tarball into a fresh temp dir → run from the INSTALLED location: `hkb version`, `hkb help`, `hkb hook stop </dev/null` (no KB_TASK ⇒ exit 0), and assert the installed package contains `skills/kanban/SKILL.md` and `templates/` (proves `files` shipped the runtime set from node A).
- Wire it as a job in the test workflow so a tarball regression can never reach a release (release workflow from node B depends on tests passing).

## Done when
The smoke job passes in CI and fails if `files` in package.json drops `skills/`.
title: Smoke-test the packed artifact in CI
